response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive senior-level software development experience with a strong technical background, open-source contributions, and leadership in mentoring and knowledge-sharing. While his profile aligns well with technical aspects of the role, his leadership experience is more hands-on than strategic, and German proficiency is below the required C1 level.
strengths: Proven track record in full-stack development and architecture across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, GIS).
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective) and expertise in Linux/Unix environments.
Experience mentoring teams, organizing workshops, and advocating for best practices (TDD, CI/CD, pair programming).
concerns: Limited explicit experience in executive-level leadership or operational oversight of client projects.
German language proficiency is listed as 'Basic,' below the required C1 level.
Technical depth in UML and IT security/compliance is not prominently highlighted.
